summary: Iteration 40 — verified payment retry (API + UI), admin partial/full refunds, renewal reminders and the two new email templates, plus the iteration 35-39 regression suite. 110/111 pytest cases pass (new suite: 15/16). Regression initially failed 7 PayPal tests because a leftover TEST_ user_membership seeded by the main agent's own smoke test (no plan_id) made POST /api/checkout return 500 (KeyError 'plan_id'); after deleting that row all 95 regression tests pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end on the preview URL: retry redirects to www.paypal.com (payment NOT completed — PayPal navigation was aborted by the test), admin Refund / 'Refund more' prompt flow works with toast and a refunded-amount column, mobile 390px has no overflow on /orders and Admin -> Orders, /membership still shows 'Pay by card' + 'Subscribe with PayPal', checkout still shows pay-paypal-btn. All refunds were executed against SIMULATED (gateway=stripe_sim) seeded orders — no real money moved and no PayPal capture was refunded.

critical.issue: No Stripe branch. refund_order() only calls PayPal (gateway=='paypal') or Razorpay; for gateway=='stripe' (every real 'Pay by card' membership/pass, fulfil_order(..., 'stripe')) the order is marked refund_status=refunded/partial, the member is notified AND emailed 'your refund is on its way', but no Stripe refund API call is ever made — money is never returned. Add a Stripe refund call (or block refunds for unsupported gateways with a 400).

500 KeyError 'plan_id' when the member has an active user_memberships row without plan_id (server.py:1570 member['plan_id']; same unguarded access at :643 and :6368). Any malformed/legacy membership row hard-breaks checkout for that member. Use member.get('plan_id') and skip the discount when absent.

minor.issue: Over-refund by a cent accepted: guard is `amount > round(base_total - already + 0.01, 2)`, so a 500.00 order accepts amount=500.01 (returns 200, refunded_amount 500.01). Compare with a tolerance that cannot exceed the charge (e.g. amount - remaining > 0.005). Frontend has the same `max + 0.01` slack in Admin.jsx refund().
Endpoint itself is correct, but Dashboard retry() always calls /payments/paypal/order, so an INR (Razorpay/simulated) order is retried in USD through PayPal — no gateway choice is offered.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast prints the raw number without currency: 'Partial refund done — 300 refunded so far.' Should use money()/currency formatting.

busy state is set (setBusy(o.id)) but never used — the Retry payment button is not disabled/labelled while the retry + PayPal order call is in flight, so it can be double-clicked (each click increments retry_count and creates a new PayPal order).

issues: No layout or contrast problems found at 1920px and 390px (scrollWidth == clientWidth on both).

Member /orders is polluted with 400+ pending/failed orders left behind by earlier automated runs (434 pending/failed orders in DB) — makes the page hard to scan; consider a cleanup script for preview data.

action_items: CRITICAL: implement a Stripe refund path in refund_order() (or 400 for gateways that cannot be refunded) — card-paid orders are currently marked refunded and the member is emailed without any money moving.
Guard member.get('plan_id') in checkout()/dashboard/companion pricing so a malformed membership row cannot 500 /api/checkout.
Tighten the refund amount guard so amount cannot exceed the charged total by 0.01 (backend + Admin.jsx prompt).
Offer the original gateway on retry (INR orders currently go to PayPal in USD) and disable the Retry button while busy.
Format the refund toast amount with the order currency.
Clean up smoke-test seeds: the main agent's TEST_renewal user_memberships row was still in the DB and broke 7 PayPal tests.
critical_code_review_comments: refund_order() sends the order_refunded email and the member notification before/regardless of whether any gateway actually refunded — for unsupported gateways this is a customer-facing false promise.
server.py is 8004 lines; payments/refunds/cron should be split into modules.
retry_order() clears gateway_order_id but leaves the previous PayPal order record in paypal state; fine today, but consider marking the abandoned gateway order for reconciliation.

success_rate.backend: 99% (110/111 pytest cases; the single failure is the genuine cent over-refund bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (retry, refund prompt, mobile, membership/checkout sanity)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only, all deleted: simulated paid/partially-refunded orders (order_no prefix TEST/TESTUI, gateway stripe_sim), one pending checkout order, user_memberships rows with order_id TEST_i40_renewal (7-day expiry, auto_renews true/false) and TEST_i40_* throwaway users. Also deleted the stale TEST_renewal membership left by the main agent's smoke test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration40_retry_refund_renewal.py (retry guards, refund partial->full with membership cancel + event participant removal, RBAC, renewal reminder idempotency, email templates). It only refunds simulated stripe_sim orders — never refund a real PayPal capture (PAYPAL_ENV=live). test_cent_over_refund_rejected is expected to FAIL until the +0.01 tolerance is fixed. Renewal-reminder test uses the seeded member (not a TEST_ user) because a parallel xdist worker's session purge deletes TEST_ users mid-test. Verified: retry -> /payments/paypal/order -> www.paypal.com redirect only (aborted in test, no payment).
rca_of_the_issue: Regression failure RCA: a TEST_ user_memberships document (order_id 'TEST_renewal') left over from the main agent's renewal-reminder smoke test had no plan_id. membership_active() returned it for arjun.sethi, and checkout() dereferences member['plan_id'] unguarded (server.py:1570), so every POST /api/checkout for that member raised KeyError -> 500, failing 7 iteration-39 PayPal tests. Deleting the row restored 95/95. Fix = defensive .get() plus disciplined smoke-seed cleanup. Refund RCA: refund_order() dispatches on order['gateway'] and only handles 'paypal'/'razorpay'; 'stripe' falls through to the state update, so card payments are flagged refunded without a gateway refund.
